about: Limoncello comes from the coast around Naples, Italy, so it is fitting that this one is made in Naples, New York. Hollerhorn Distilling is Karl and Melissa Neubauer’s farm distillery, restaurant and music venue in the hills south of Canandaigua Lake, opened in 2018 and rebuilt after a fire in 2022. Karl, the distillery’s only distiller, works almost entirely with ingredients from nearby farms and is best known for spirits distilled from local maple syrup.

His limoncello follows the traditional Italian method, steeping unwaxed organic lemon zest in a strong base spirit and sweetening it with organic cane sugar. What sets it apart is that base: instead of neutral grain spirit, Hollerhorn uses Silver Leaf, its unaged maple spirit, distilled from Finger Lakes maple syrup, yeast and water. It is bottled at 85 proof, a little stronger than most limoncellos. Serve it ice cold after dinner, the way it is poured along the Amalfi Coast.
title: Hollerhorn Distilling Limoncello
